name: DiscussionThread
tagline: Discussion Thread puts a conversation right on the record it is about: a purchase request, work order, contract, case or event.
description: Discussion Thread puts a conversation right on the record it is about: a purchase request, work order, contract, case or event. People post comments, questions, decisions and actions, reply, @mention colleagues, like and pin important points, and mark questions answered or actions done. The whole discussion is saved in one multi-line text column, so it works with SharePoint lists, Dataverse tables or a canvas collection without extra tables.
features: Edit or delete your own comments (optional time window) with Undo
Filter chips with counts, sort, day grouping
Show more for long text and older threads
Masked and malformed-value states and a phone layout, Outputs counts
